title: S01T05 - Establish the cross-platform public release CI baseline
description: Create the release-gate matrix for macOS, Linux, and Windows, including clean install, package smoke, docs/schema checks, migrations, and browser or terminal verification where applicable.
acceptanceCriteria: CI runs the supported build, typecheck, tests, package smoke, docs/schema checks, migration fixtures, and installer smoke on macOS, Linux, and Windows.
Failures identify platform, install channel, CLI/runtime versions, and exact reproduction commands.
All repository changes are captured in one or more scoped Git checkpoint commits, or closeout records an accepted no-repo-changes reason.
Relevant automated tests, documentation checks, and strict Boreal health checks pass before closeout.
